The Chef was Majorly Annoying
Feb 2023
After a long and stressful day I wanted a meal in my hotel room at Mercure. I go to the hotel's restaurant, Flame Grill & Bar, to place a to-go order and was greeted warmly by staff.

After looking at the menu I ordered soup, fruit juice blend, steak and dessert. 

I found the steak recipe I wanted but did not like the cut of meat that was used. It was a tenderloin but I like the cheaper ribeye. I told staff that I would pay the full cost of the premium steak but wanted to substitute the ribeye for the tenderloin. Should not have been a problem but the chef made at fuss about it. It took about 10 minutes to straighten it out. I'm paying more for cheaper meat. What could possibly be the issue with that?

The staff member returns and asks what type of sauce I wanted. The steak comes with scallops and prawns. The option was mushrooms, bbq and another sauce that made no sense with seafood. A garlic sauce was an option for a steak item on the restaurant menu so I asked for garlic sauce. 

The chef refused. I canceled my order. I left the hotel and walked down the street to order steak from another hotel restaurant. Major inconvenience after not eating the entire day, being exhausted and having to jump through hoops for an order that did not require any special ingredients or preparation. 

By the way, there were only two other occupied tables with a total of five guests in the entire restaurant including myself.
